decisions.reason: The cutting and creasing finisher is close to the core postpress portfolio and uses existing distribution and service routines, and with no performance shortfall reported there is no trigger for problemistic search.

The UV spot varnishing system is distant from the core and its results are still uncertain, but as a promoted flagship with a German premiere it gets more time, and industry growth gives the slack to carry it.
The sheet preparation module builds on the modular line offering and supports sales of complete systems at low carrying cost, so it likely meets aspirations.
The B2 multifinisher is a core-adjacent flagship that matches the move toward automated finishing workflows and is very likely to meet aspirations.
The hybrid saddle stitcher strengthens the established booklet-making offer and serves existing customer demand, so there is little pressure to withdraw it.
